items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was wondering, you know, also about Ramis and Bebe. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I played bass drum with Ramis... But I never played, I wasn't playing when Bill was playing drums...

ctx.x: He was down with Eureka at the Armistice Day one time at Chalmette.
I was wondering, you know, also about Ramis and Bebe.

Well, I played bass drum with Ramis. Ramis played snare drum and I played bass drum with them already. But I never played, I wasn't playing when Bill was playing drums, snare drum when he was playing drums. I wasn't playing.
